indicators.label: Religion-response denominator
indicators.description: Residents aged 15 and over in the municipality and census wave with a valid stated religion/no-religion response.
indicators.method: 2011: INE 0006396 Total minus Não resposta. 2021: INE 0011644 Total; the 2021 API extract exposes no Não resposta category.
indicators.quality_notes: The denominator is the source religion-response total for the age-15-plus universe, not the full resident population.

indicators.label: Religious affiliation %
indicators.description: Share of the source religion-response denominator reporting any named religion.
indicators.method: 2011: 100 * (Católica + Ortodoxa + Protestante + Outra cristã + Judaica + Muçulmana + Outra não cristã) / (Total - Não resposta). 2021: 100 * (Católica + Ortodoxa + Protestante/Evangélica + Testemunhas do Jeová + Outra cristã + Budista + Hindu + Judaica + Muçulmana + Outra não cristã) / Total.
indicators.quality_notes: The headline construct is any named religion; detailed denomination categories are not crosswalked across waves.

indicators.label: No religion %
indicators.description: Share of the source religion-response denominator reporting Sem religião.
indicators.method: 2011: 100 * Sem religião / (Total - Não resposta). 2021: 100 * Sem religião / Total.
indicators.quality_notes: Sem religião is the INE source label in both shipped waves.
